text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text:
That girl, Kokkoro, calls you \"my lord,\" right?
Are you of noble birth? ...You really don't look it.
Who exactly are you?
choice_data_list: I am Sigurd of the Fulgor!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなた、
コッコロに主さまって呼ばれてるわよね？
偉い身分なのかしら？　
……
そうは見えないけど。
一体何者なの？

text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text:
You're... a knight?
Who calls knights \"Mister\"?
Isn't that a little out of place?
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士……
なの？
そもそも
くんって何？
どうしてそんなに気さくなの？

text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text:
A prince... Yeah, sure.
Huh? You really have been called that?
Now I just feel more confused...
text_block_list.orig_text:
王子……
冗談ね？
え？　
ほんとうにそう呼ばれてる？
余計分からなくなってきたわ……

text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what to say to that.
No, don't start spouting catchphrases.
What are you even doing?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どう反応していいか分からないわ。
いえ、
キメ台詞を言われても困るわ。
なんなのかしら一体……
